selection_basis: original has 137 machine blocks and 112 reduced nodes versus baseline 138/113
baseline non-native success/error cleanup joins an output-pointer reload
preserve two ProgramError conversions and both six-account cleanups
prior native-early control is used only in new compositions, never repeated alone
two unified forms verified the 112-node topology but shifted later Anchor error line constants; exactly two line-preserving followups are justified

native_axes.q: baseline question-mark propagation; no standalone rebuild
native_axes.bind-map: named Anchor Result after map_err, then question-mark propagation
native_axes.match: explicit Ok/Err propagation without a whole-branch early return
native_axes.early: prior native early-return component only composed with novel non-native forms

nonnative_axes.bind-q: bound ProgramResult propagated after temporary cleanup
nonnative_axes.bind-map: map error before temporary cleanup, bind Anchor Result, then propagate
nonnative_axes.scoped-bind-q: CPI locals scoped before ProgramResult propagation
nonnative_axes.scoped-bind-map: CPI locals scoped after conversion but before outer propagation
nonnative_axes.match-map: explicit match propagation of mapped CPI Result
nonnative_axes.scoped-match-map: scoped mapped CPI Result followed by explicit match propagation

unified_axes: original physical source-line preservation for the two verified-topology forms
forbidden_repeats_excluded: named non-native Instruction/AccountInfo locals with direct question-mark
native early return with unchanged baseline non-native branch
H3 wrapper/helper, argument reorder, visibility, and older H3 Result controls
search_space.deduplication: 26 distinct full migrate_v2.rs SHA-256 values verified before followup builds; unstripped SHA-256 after build; equivalent outputs grouped in SUMMARY.json
